Рубины, или я никогда не видел рубина!", "source_sha256": "5e2fc8870138abc2bcc59576b83ac0915bfcba7d0964f1223b6738499bd91d4f", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u016-r0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "aef6b060235a7150de51e2c9860935993415b91436cafcaeb050723da66b0cd7"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u016-r0063", "target": "Они проследили за его взглядом и увидели каменную статую приземистой, грузной женщины, которая смотрела на них красными глазами с раскрытым ртом. Рот был так велик, что превращал остальное лицо в карикатуру. Рядом с ней, высеченная тоже из камня, но в несколько более героических очертаниях, стояла ещё более непристойная и отвратительная мужская статуя: одно ухо у неё было соразмерное, а другое — так же уродливо огромно, как рот женской.", "source_sha256": "21af5e0157f631ed7e432726a867eee94e254ed513a290330881415719ec647a", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u016-r0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "43ac58f2a3983cfe823f47111f902dc2ad5b525e5c4df873fe768310f93bbbcb"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u016-r0064", "tag": "p", "text": "“The beauteous dame must be Chia all right,” Henry grinned. “But who’s her gentleman friend with the elephant ear and the green eyes?”", "sha256": "3263c04d4b0f30d670cb21834081a047a4825ae21deae03169bd95dcc7281b2a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1319]", "source_html": "

They wandered vainly about the chamber, tapping the walls and floor, seeking for cunningly-hidden passageways or unguessable clues to the hiding place of the treasure.", "sha256": "bb617d3dcc31b5386ddbb588c033dfd63af69086f61f009b6cc4689d53324c02", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1324]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u016-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“Bones of tierra caliente men, two idols, two emeralds of enormous size, two rubies ditto, and ourselves, are all the place contains,” Francis summed up. “Only a couple of things remain for us to do: go back and bring up Ricardo and the mules to make camp outside; and bring up the old gentleman and his sacred knots if we have to carry him.”", "sha256": "145f56c83032cf300f254287b01b79b1a2dceb5d2e90f5cf525ffd1d8c657420", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1325]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u016-r0072", "tag": "p", "text": "Back on the barking sands the peon and his father knelt in the circle so noisily drawn by the old man’s forefinger. A local rain squall beat upon them, and, though the peon shivered, the old man prayed on oblivious to what might happen to his skin in the way of wind and water. It was because the peon shivered and was uncomfortable that he observed two things which his father missed. First, he saw Alvarez Torres and José Mancheno cautiously venture out from the jungle upon the sand. Next, he saw a miracle. The miracle was that the pair of them trudged steadily across the sand without causing the slightest sound to arise from their progress. When they had disappeared ahead, he touched his finger tentatively to the sand, and aroused no ghostly whisperings. He thrust his finger into the sand, yet all was silent, as was it silent when he buffeted the sand heartily with the flat of his palm. The passing shower had rendered the sand dumb.", "sha256": "29f52a825fe53197dd0b37827edfc9247c6af97ee42101acc250dc797b2bcbbd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1327]", "source_html": "

Back on the barking sands the peon and his father knelt in the circle so noisily drawn by the old man’s forefinger. A local rain squall beat upon them, and, though the peon shivered, the old man prayed on oblivious to what might happen to his skin in the way of wind and water. It was because the peon shivered and was uncomfortable that he observed two things which his father missed. First, he saw Alvarez Torres and José Mancheno cautiously venture out from the jungle upon the sand. Next, he saw a miracle. The miracle was that the pair of them trudged steadily across the sand without causing the slightest sound to arise from their progress. When they had disappeared ahead, he touched his finger tentatively to the sand, and aroused no ghostly whisperings. He thrust his finger into the sand, yet all was silent, as was it silent when he buffeted the sand heartily with the flat of his palm. The passing shower had rendered the sand dumb.

He shook his father out of his prayers, announcing:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u016-r0074", "tag": "p", "text": "“The sand no longer is noisy. It is as silent as the grave. The voice of the sand is not.
